Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ACTREC Project Technical Support - II Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ACTREC Project Technical Support - II?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Technical Support - II position at ACTREC is scheduled for 30 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Technical Support - II post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is either 12th in Science with MLT or equivalent plus 5 years of experience, or a B.Sc. degree with 2 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Technical Support - II position is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support - II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 26,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Technical Support - II position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Examination followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the ACTREC office in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra (Pincode: 410210).

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Technical Support - II is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Maharashtra apply?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any restrictions for candidates from outside Maharashtra. However, candidates must meet the eligibility criteria and attend the walk-in interview in person.
